summary: A draft plan, written by Vint Cerf and Jon Postel, for moving computer mail from the old ARPANET protocols to the new Internet protocols. It aims to keep mail working and minimize the impact on users while both sets of protocols are in use.

eli5.summary: Moving house while still getting your letters is tricky. This plan explains how to keep email arriving while the network switches to a new way of doing things.
